prod.alert: Cache errors: OOM command not allowed
prod.log:
$ redis-cli INFO memory | grep -E 'used_memory_human|maxmemory'
used_memory_human:4.00G
maxmemory_human:4.00G
maxmemory_policy:noeviction
note: this Redis is only a cache
prod.why: For a cache, evicting the least-recently-used keys is right. FLUSHALL empties everything and stampedes the database.

prod.log:

arm64
note: cluster nodes are amd64; image built on a laptop

web: 3 replicas behind a round-robin load balancer
SESSION_STORE=memory
note: sticky sessions were removed in #210

prod.log:

      System clock synchronized: no
                    NTP service: inactive
$ date -u
Wed Nov 11 07:42:10 UTC 2026   (4 minutes ahead)

drwxr-xr-x 2 root root 4096 /backups

prod.alert: Users still see the old frontend after deploy

cache-control: max-age=31536000
x-cache: Hit from cloudfront
note: index.html was uploaded with a 1-year cache

heap: 210MB -> 980MB in 6h
